core_obligations: Part (1), reflection of injections (proof lines 5759-5770): for an etale U over X the author chooses a covering by open and closed subschemes W_i of base changes X x_Y V_i, shows that the sections of F over U inject into the product over the W_i, and that each F(W_i) is a direct summand of f_{small,*}F(V_i), which gives that f_{small,*} reflects injections.

Part (1), reflection of surjections (proof lines 5772-5787): for a map a whose pushforward is surjective the author reduces to lifting a section over X x_Y V etale locally, using the direct summand description, which gives reflection of surjections.

Parts (2) and (3) (proof lines 5789-5792): the surjectivity of f_{small}^{-1}f_{small,*}F -> F and the faithfulness of f_{small,*} follow formally from part (1) by the cited result on reflecting surjections.
proof_roadmap: Use property (A) to cover an etale U by open and closed pieces inside base changes.
Read off that the pushforward reflects injections and surjections.
Deduce the unit surjectivity and faithfulness formally.
difficulty_reason: The lemma derives three consequences of property (A) for a morphism of schemes: the small pushforward reflects injections and surjections, the unit f_{small}^{-1}f_{small,*}F -> F is surjective, and the pushforward is faithful (statement lines 5737-5757, with property (A) delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5708-5726). The proof uses the local description supplied by property (A) to split the sections over an etale U into a product over open and closed pieces of base changes (proof lines 5759-5787), which yields both reflection statements, and then deduces the remaining two clauses formally (proof lines 5789-5792). The non-formal content is the direct summand computation in the first part. The claim is H2: one local computation plus a formal consequence.
